data.name: Humamah
data.gender_notes: Humamah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-m-m', meaning 'to protect, guard, and maintain'. In Islamic tradition, Humamah is a powerful name that evokes images of strength and protection. The name Humamah carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Humamah usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who is believed to have the ability to give life and nurture it, both physically and emotionally.
data.etymology: Humamah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Humamah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
